title: Photo Album for Wife: A Birthday or Anniversary Gift | Albums.ink
desc: Photo album for your wife's birthday or anniversary: what to include, caption ideas and how to add videos and your own voice. Free, no ads.
h1: Photo album for your wife: your story together as a gift
lead: “Photo album for wife birthday” and “photo album gift for wife” are common searches in Canada, and most results are printed photo books. A printed book is lovely, but it can't hold the video of your first dance or your voice telling the story of how you met. An online story album can, and you can make one tonight for free.
body: ## What to put in a photo album for your wife
- How it started: the first photo together, the first trip, the first apartment.
- Big days: the proposal, the wedding, moving into your home, the kids arriving.
- Seasons: cottage weekends, skating on the rink, fall road trips, summer by the lake.
- Everyday life: Sunday breakfasts, the dog, her favourite coffee spot.
- Things you never said out loud: a short caption under each photo is enough.
## Make it a free story album

On Albums you create a story album with chapters, photos, videos and voice notes, and you can narrate it in your own voice. Free photos are kept up to 2048 px on the long edge. No ads, unlimited albums, and the album stays as long as you want it.
1. Create a free album, e.g. “Our ten years”.
2. Add chapters: How we met, Our wedding, Our home, What's next.
3. Upload photos and short videos, and write a caption for each.
4. Record a voice note in the browser for the chapters that matter most.
5. Want the kids or a sibling to help? Invite one co-author who is already your friend on Albums.
More ideas: anniversary photo album ideas and how to add your voice to photos.

Add your wife as a friend and choose Friends — that includes all your friends, so to show it only to her choose Friends, except… and exclude the others. Check again after you add new friends. Only me does not give access through a link. You can also hide single files and download the whole album as one ZIP to keep a copy.
Send the link with a card on her birthday or your anniversary. The link shows a cover preview; she opens the album in the browser and signs in with Google.

faq: What should I put in a photo album for my wife?
How you met, your wedding, your home, trips, everyday moments and a caption or voice note about why each memory matters.
Can I make it for free?
Yes. A story album on Albums is free, with chapters, photos, videos and voice notes. No ads.
How do I share it only with my wife?
Add her as a friend, choose Friends, except… and exclude everyone else. Check again after adding new friends.
Can I keep a copy of the album?
Yes. You can download the whole album as one ZIP.
